task: Schedule-Free AdamW against a tuned cosine schedule on the MLP trainer

paper.title: Schedule-Free Learning: Replacing Schedules with Iteration-Based Averages
paper.authors: Aaron Defazio, Xingyu Yang, Harsh Mehta, Konstantin Mishchenko, Ahmed Khaled, Ashok Cutkosky

hypothesis: Same question as the logistic suite, on a model with curvature: does schedule-free AdamW beat, or at least match, a cosine schedule that was tuned over both its learning rate and its minimum-learning-rate factor - and does a constant learning rate remain competitive?
